nodes.label: Authoritative Job Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Ten-state pure module (new/scheduled/queued/running/pause_requested/paused/completed/failed/interrupted/cancelled) with legal-transition table, active-slot sets, and session-ownership reconciliation; an intermediate frame survives load only if the current session owns it and its pid is alive, else it goes to interrupted, fixing the naive reset that would clobber a live job once concurrency exists.

nodes.label: Clean-State Packaging Gate
nodes.rationale: check_clean_state() fails the build if the onedir bundles job/dev data (jobs/exports/thumbs/LecturePackData/study_packs, *config.json, *.job.json, *.db/*.sqlite, stray app *.json) and asserts the engine payload is present + non-empty; wired after bundle_engine() so packaged app never ships user data.

nodes.label: Packaged WebEngine Architecture
nodes.rationale: Packaged app = WebEngine (app/desktop/main.py → app/ui vanilla-JS window.LP + app.css via bridge.py QWebChannel); engine = lecturepack/ via engine_adapter.py::LecturePackAdapter; bridge.js SIGNALS array must stay in sync with bridge.py signals; legacy lecturepack/ui/ PySide pages are not shipped.

nodes.label: Manual workflow_dispatch Release Cut
nodes.rationale: .github/workflows/release.yml is manual workflow_dispatch(tag); releases are cut from locally-verified artifacts so published checksums always match verified binaries, avoiding a non-reproducible rebuild on tag push.

nodes.label: Private-Repo Updater Blocker
nodes.rationale: The updater queries the GitHub releases API without a token (no embedded secret by design); on a private repo the feed returns 403/404 so end users never receive in-app update notifications. Repo (or releases) must be public or a public update manifest/mirror configured; visibility intentionally not changed here.

nodes.label: SHA256-Verified Atomic Download
nodes.rationale: Download to cache with .partial, SHA256 verified before atomic rename; mismatch/cancel deletes the file; never launches unverified content. Digest sources (SHA256SUMS.txt + GitHub asset digest) reconciled when both present.

nodes.label: Visible Inno Installer Handoff
nodes.rationale: Install handoff uses visible Inno installer /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS /NORESTART (never /VERYSILENT//SILENT), blocked while a lecture is processing, saves state then quits; args passed as a list (no shell string). Portable/source builds never self-replace.

nodes.label: Updater Security/Privacy Model
nodes.rationale: HTTPS only in production; asset host locked to GitHub; test-only feed injectable via env LECTUREPACK_UPDATE_FEED/HOSTS; release notes rendered as escaped text; no token embedded/logged; no lecture data sent; LecturePackData untouched.

nodes.label: Stable AppId Upgrades
nodes.rationale: AppId in lecturepack.iss is unchanged (stable GUID) so updates install over the existing app and LecturePackData (separate from {app}) survives.

nodes.label: Handoff — Milestone 1 (Group Study Backend & AI Gateway)
Layered Architecture (UI/Controller/Service/Infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Layered UI/Controller/Service/Infrastructure; QProcess for external tools (FFmpeg, whisper-cli), QThread workers for internal processing; per-stage state machine with atomic JSON writes for crash recovery; plain files + JSON manifests (no database); application-relative paths for bundled binaries, never system PATH.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Technology Choices
nodes.rationale: PySide6 6.11.x widgets; whisper.cpp v1.9.1 pinned (MIT) with CPU primary + optional Vulkan on AMD Vega 56; three-stage slide CV cascade (dHash+SSIM+histogram) deterministic and LLM-free; img2pdf (lossless) for slides; ReportLab Platypus for study-pack PDF; self-contained HTML with base64 images; PyInstaller standalone directory; ~/LecturePackData configurable user-accessible data dir; opencv-python-headless to avoid Qt DLL conflicts.

nodes.label: Per-Phase Authorization Gating
nodes.rationale: Do not begin Phase 2 until Phase 1 passes all acceptance tests and gets explicit user approval; phases authorize narrowly scoped work only. Acceptance tests P1-1..P1-10 map each deliverable to concrete evidence.

nodes.label: Media Provenance Gate
nodes.rationale: Owner confirms demo_lecture.mp4 was created under a controlled account with redistribution rights, contains no unlicensed third-party ingredients, and the thumbnail is derived from the MP4; declaration recorded in app/assets/demo/PROVENANCE.md bound to shipped hashes.

nodes.label: SETUP_REQUIRED Admission Gate
nodes.rationale: A blocked/corrupt executable launch becomes bounded failed evidence and SETUP_REQUIRED, never persisted healthy state; every adapter/updater-facing bridge action is centrally guarded while admission is SETUP_REQUIRED and emits the diagnostics transport payload before collaborator access.

nodes.label: Pre-Visible Theme Readiness (VIS-01/02)
nodes.rationale: Theme initialization runs before window show(), preventing Light↔Dark color flashes; entrance animations do not replay on theme toggle or option updates.

nodes.label: CSS box-shadow Tour Spotlight
nodes.rationale: Spotlight uses non-blocking pure CSS box-shadow (0 0 0 9999px rgba(...)) with pointer-events:none, eliminating SVG mask hit-testing locks; tour card clamps within viewport across 1220/820/640px widths.

nodes.label: Coalesced/Deduplicated Pipeline Updates
nodes.rationale: Processing status/stage/progress/log paints are coalesced and capped at four visible batches per second; existing rows updated in place, new log rows appended as a fragment to avoid relayout storms.

nodes.label: 100% Offline Local Processing
nodes.rationale: Offline local processing; zero telemetry/analytics; zero network requests beyond local LM Studio and first-run model downloads.

nodes.label: jobs_changed Direct-Array Contract Repair
nodes.rationale: Repaired renderer-facing jobs_changed shape to the direct job summary array expected by app/ui/app.js.

nodes.label: Qt Application Kept as Fallback
nodes.rationale: Build the first real Electron path by reusing current HTML/CSS/JS UI, existing Python engine, packaged sidecar, JSONL IPC, and existing data/job format while keeping the Qt application as fallback; Qt widgets/WebEngine stay out of the sidecar.

nodes.label: Six Student Study Modes (Guide/Flashcards/Quiz/Ask/Teach Me/Quick Study)
Anonymous Server-Controlled AI Routing + Fallback
nodes.rationale: HMAC installation tokens, eight-task allowlist, bounded schemas, rate limits; every task needs >=2 routes on independent endpoint hosts; provider rejection/malformed/transient failures advance to next route; provider credentials/models/route selection kept out of the packaged desktop; normal success hides attempted routes.

nodes.label: Guided Demo Packaged Output Fix
nodes.rationale: The Windows package previously omitted demo.data.js, the hero, and both prebuilt slide images, so packaged users saw fallback copy in every content chapter; the packager now copies the curated demo directory to the renderer's exact resources/assets/demo path and the release validator requires every file.

nodes.label: Authenticode Code-Signing Gap (BLOCKER)
nodes.rationale: Executable/sidecar/installer report NotSigned; no code-signing certificate in user or local machine stores and no signing env var/file in repo; this cannot be repaired in source or configured on NVIDIA/Cloudflare — a trusted Authenticode certificate + private key must be supplied before a signed public installer can be produced. Until then keep artifacts unsigned, do not label as signed, do not publish as the final trusted installer.

nodes.label: Groq Audio Chunking / Merging (23 MiB, FLAC, overlap)
Online → Private Local Fallback
nodes.rationale: If connection fails, API key missing, or quota exhausted, the pipeline falls back to Private Local; fallback preserves slide detection, redacts secrets from errors, promotes canonical files only after complete validation.

nodes.label: Per-Job Online Consent + Redaction
nodes.rationale: Online mode disabled by default; per-job audio-only upload notice must be confirmed before secret read/upload; key stored only in Windows Credential Manager under LecturePack/Groq API Key; scans remove keys/headers/secret URL components from logs.

nodes.label: Local Fallback Absolute-Path Bugfix
nodes.rationale: Local fallback from Online modes failed to load the whisper.cpp model because JobController._run_local_fallback passed the relative model name 'ggml-base.en.bin' which failed os.path.isfile() outside the process CWD; fixed by resolving to absolute path from model search directories before launching.

nodes.label: Online Accurate Intro-Omission Limitation
nodes.rationale: Groq Online Accurate omitted the first ~20s of a low-volume intro; both Local and Groq Online Fast transcribed it correctly — Accurate shows a tendency to skip low-volume/noisy intros.

nodes.label: Byte-Identical Local Cache Fingerprints
nodes.rationale: Implicit and explicit local cache fingerprints stay byte-identical to v1.1; non-local requested/effective keys isolate fallback output and invalidate it when a missing provider later becomes available — preserving cache compatibility.

nodes.label: Durable Mastery Writes (fsync + os.replace + .bak)
nodes.rationale: study-progress-v2.json retains the previous valid generation as .bak before advancing the primary; writes use a unique same-dir temp file, explicit flush + fsync, then os.replace; failed replacement leaves the previous primary intact; missing/truncated/invalid primary recovers from the valid rolling backup; invalid primary cannot overwrite backup.

nodes.label: Handoff — Phase v1.3 Incremental Transcript Streaming (AD-16)
200ms QTimer Log Coalescing (UI freeze fix)
nodes.rationale: Transcribe-stage log chunks are coalesced in JobController and flushed to stage_log on a 200ms QTimer (plus final flush), removing the QTextEdit.insertPlainText relayout storm that froze the GUI during long transcriptions.

nodes.label: JobController NOT moved to QThread (decision)
nodes.rationale: AD-16 records why JobController was not moved to a QThread (risked concurrency regressions); incremental parsing and log throttling met the streaming goal instead.

hyperedges.label: Electron Migration Progression (Spike → Vertical Slice → Production Core → Phase 9)
